The '''An'yettu Islands''' was an archipelago from which the [[An'yettu clan]] of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] hailed. Located west of [[Betu/Legends|Betu]] in the [[Wesessa Sea/Legends|Wesessa Sea]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] prevented the An'yettu from expanding beyond this chain of islands.
